knowledge.name: Synthetic order and production snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed fictional orders provide customer, product, quantity, value, completion, promise-date, status, and delay-risk evidence.

knowledge.name: Synthetic shipment evidence
knowledge.detail: A fixed carrier record supplies tracking, route, weight, ship date, estimated delivery, and recorded transit status for review.

knowledge.name: Delay, recovery, and account context
knowledge.detail: Bundled delay causes, revised dates, recovery options, owners, customer tiers, response windows, and channel preferences ground drafts.

knowledge.name: Review rules and production seams
knowledge.detail: Locked evidence rules and documented ERP, MES, carrier, CRM, and communication seams separate pilot facts from future live access.

intelligence_processing.name: Order status and risk aggregation
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates order value and fixed days-left evidence, identifies delayed records, and prioritizes internal customer-service review.

intelligence_processing.name: Shipment evidence validation review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes the recorded shipment while identifying carrier milestones and delivery proof that still require approved-system validation.

intelligence_processing.name: Delay and recovery synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines cause, schedule impact, cost, recovery options, ownership, SLA, and preferred channel without changing operations.

intelligence_processing.name: Channel-aware communication drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Prepares customer-specific status drafts using tier, channel, owner, order, shipment, and delay evidence for authorized review only.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-led bounded routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes service, account, and operations questions to one deterministic operation and does not invent absent records or actions.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent exposes four read-only operations through local Brainstem chat, streaming, API, and health surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language previews while the validated pilot remains Draft and unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Reviewed communication workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Customer service, account, and operations users review evidence and message drafts before an authorized sender uses an approved channel.

management_reporting.name: Order Status Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports order progress, promise dates, values, days left, delayed status, total book value, and at-risk value from the fixed snapshot.

management_reporting.name: Shipment Tracking Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports carrier, tracking, route, weight, dates, and recorded status while requiring confirmation in the approved carrier system.

management_reporting.name: Internal Delay Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports delayed order evidence, cause, revised date, cost, recovery options, owner, SLA, and channel without changing a schedule.

management_reporting.name: Customer Update Drafts
management_reporting.detail: Presents tailored status, shipment, and delay drafts for approval; no email, EDI, portal, Teams, or other message is sent.

tools.name: OrderStatusCommunicationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts four skills and two knowledge files in a validated Draft pilot; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill evidence.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and MES
tools.detail: Documented approved seam for live order and production evidence; the packaged pilot has no live read or write connection.

tools.name: Approved carrier and logistics tracking
tools.detail: Future least-privilege source for shipment milestones and proof; current tracking evidence is fixed and synthetic.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
tools.detail: Documented approved seam for account, owner, preference, and customer context; no production CRM is connected.

tools.name: Power Automate and approved communication channels
tools.detail: Future approval and sending seam for email, EDI, portal, or Teams; the current package sends no message or notification.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every identifier, person, company, date, amount, status, tracking record, recovery option, and message is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Order lookup, shipment tracking, delay review, and customer-update drafting remain independently callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Evidence validation and fail-closed handling
supporting_features.detail: Carrier and production facts require approved-system validation, and absent records are not browsed, invented, or silently substituted.

supporting_features.name: Reviewed communications approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Drafts preserve customer tier, channel, owner, and source evidence while requiring human review and an authorized sender.

supporting_features.name: No operational write or message sending
supporting_features.detail: No order, schedule, shipment, sourcing, logistics, recovery, CRM, email, EDI, portal, Teams, or other action is changed or sent.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future-action pattern
supporting_features.detail: Any future action tool must be separate, authenticated, role-authorized, state-validated, explicitly confirmed, and audited.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed deterministic and Copilot Studio previews while both validated agents remained Draft and unpublished.
